comparison.objective: Select, mount, lock, and set a zoom lens while retaining 50 mm; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use rotational adjustment and a physical lock, but PR-1611 adds inverted bayonet alignment/insertion and pin locking; candidate uses a recessed setscrew and tunes from repeated carriage impacts.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1611 requires passive 48–52 mm retention for 20 seconds after release; candidate requires two safe stops plus collar-drift resistance. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared adjustment-and-retention pattern, but the candidate’s tested ability is dynamic response commissioning rather than mounting and holding an optical setting.
